record.category: relay/P2P — pure SIGNALLING, zero relayed bytes

free_tier.stated: Trystero makes browsers discover each other and communicate directly. No accounts. No deploying infrastructure. Just import and connect.

per_object_cap.stated: Each room defaults to a 256 MiB receive budget.

egress.terms: Data flows peer-to-peer via WebRTC; the signalling network never sees the payload. The operator's cost is SDP messages only.

record.chaining: The cleanest signalling example: because only SDP crosses the third party, there is no bandwidth quota to hit and no operator who could impose one. Note the caveat that WebRTC needs a TURN relay when both peers are behind symmetric NAT. That is where real relaying cost reappears, and Trystero does not supply it.
record.limits_note: Signalling only. Browser WebRTC connection-count limits force a room/namespace design.

identity_cost.detail: Trystero makes browsers discover each other and communicate directly. No accounts. No deploying infrastructure. Just import and connect.

record.reliability_note: No TURN service included; symmetric-NAT pairs will fail to connect rather than fall back.
record.confidence_note: the github.com/dmotz/trystero README states browsers discover each other and communicate directly with no accounts and no infrastructure to deploy

evidence.proved: 'To establish a direct peer-to-peer connection with WebRTC, a signalling channel is needed to exchange peer information (SDP). Typically this involves running your own matchmaking server but Trystero abstracts this away'; strategies listed: BitTorrent, Nostr, MQTT, Supabase, Firebase, IPFS, self-hosted WebSocket relay
'Use our free cloud server or host your own PeerServer' (free signalling broker; relayed data still needs a TURN server)
the README states Trystero needs no accounts and no infrastructure
evidence.quote: Trystero makes browsers discover each other and communicate directly. No accounts. No deploying infrastructure. Just import and connect.

evidence.proved: the README states a default 256 MiB receive budget per room
evidence.quote: Each room defaults to a 256 MiB receive budget. Set maxReceiveBytes in the room config to allow larger files or reduce memory use.

record.notes: No storage and no relayed bandwidth: Trystero borrows an existing decentralised network purely to exchange WebRTC SDP offers.
